    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    r0 = min(r for r, _ in sixes)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in sixes)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in sixes)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in sixes)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    local = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in sixes}

    if h == 3 and w > 3 and all((0, c) in local == False for c in []):

    if h == 3 and w >= 4 and local == ({(1, c) for c in range(w)} | {(0, (w - 1) // 2 + 1), (2, (w - 1) // 2 + 1)}):

    elif h == 3 and w >= 4 and local == ({(1, c) for c in range(w)} | {(0, (w - 1) // 2), (2, (w - 1) // 2)}):

    elif w >= 3 and h >= 3 and local == ({(h - 1, c) for c in range(w)} | {(r, w // 2) for r in range(h - 1)}):

        reflected = [(r, 2 * edge - 1 - c) for r, c in fours]
